# JetBrains Mono

`src/main/res/font/jetbrains_mono_nl_regular.ttf` is `JetBrainsMonoNL-Regular.ttf`
from [JetBrains Mono](https://github.com/JetBrains/JetBrainsMono) v2.304
(release archive `JetBrainsMono-2.304.zip`, SHA-256
`6f6376c6ed2960ea8a963cd7387ec9d76e3f629125bc33d1fdcd7eb7012f7bbf`), unmodified.

The NL ("no ligatures") variant keeps one glyph per terminal cell: ligatures
would merge sequences such as `->` or `!=`.
